title: Secrets Stored in the Software Installation Directory
pattern: Placing environment-specific configuration files or secrets inside the software installation directory tree.
why_bad: Software updates or upgrades are highly likely to overwrite the installation tree, deleting live configurations. Additionally, operators copying install trees across nodes silently propagate bad configurations, and zip dumps for debugging leak active credentials.
detection: The application config loader maps relative directory paths pointing within the executable binary's local folder.
fix: Store the production configurations entirely separate from the installation directory (such as standard etc/ or var/ paths) so they are preserved during binary upgrades.
source: [Pragmatic Programmers] Michael T. Nygard - *Release It!_ Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software* (2007, Pragmatic Bookshelf).pdf, Section 14.2.
